label: freetoken-pr270-b12x-all-c8k
answer:
## Findings

FINDING: bridged_request_demultiplexer_00.c:emit_policy_0005 | CWE-121 | Unbounded `strcpy()` of attacker-controlled User-Agent into fixed 64-byte stack buffer `scratch` (the computed length `n` is never used to bound the copy) — remote stack buffer overflow.

FINDING: bridged_session_table_01.c:flush_record_0104 | CWE-190 | `count * elem_size` is computed in 32-bit arithmetic and wraps before the `MAX_TABLE_BYTES` check, producing an undersized allocation that callers fill/index with `count × elem_size` bytes — heap overflow.

FINDING: bridged_configuration_loader_02.c:rebalance_digest_0204 | CWE-193 | Loop condition `i <= dst_sz` writes `dst[dst_sz]` and, when `src` is longer, the terminator at `dst[dst_sz+1]` — off-by-one write past the end of the destination buffer.

FINDING: bridged_access_log_writer_03.c:reset_chunk_0308 | CWE-416 | On the `REQ_ABORTED` path `pr` is freed and `cs->pending` nulled, then `pr->method/pr->path/pr->status` are dereferenced by `log_request()` — use-after-free.

FINDING: bridged_TLS_record_helper_04.c:rebalance_cursor_0402 | CWE-415 | `u->tmpbuf` is freed without being nulled, then freed a second time on the `error_seen` path — double free.

FINDING: bridged_upload_staging_05.c:seal_backlog_0504 | CWE-134 | Attacker-influenced `client_id` is formatted into `line` and passed to `syslog()` as the format string — format-string injection (information leak or arbitrary write via `%n`).

FINDING: bridged_header_parser_06.c:merge_record_0602 | CWE-78 | Request-supplied `archive_name` is interpolated into a command string passed to `system()` — OS command injection via shell metacharacters (`;`, backticks, `$()`).

FINDING: bridged_route_matcher_07.c:rebalance_policy_0702 | CWE-22 | Only a leading `/` is rejected; `..` components are not sanitized, so a relative path such as `../../etc/passwd` escapes `DOC_ROOT` — path traversal on `open()`.

FINDING: bridged_rate_limiter_08.c:claim_record_0805 | CWE-195 | Negative `len` passes the `len > (int)dst_sz` check and is converted to a huge `size_t` in `memcpy(dst, payload, len)` — out-of-bounds write; missing `len < 0` validation.

FINDING: bridged_cache_index_09.c:reset_bucket_0906 | CWE-367 | `stat()`-then-`open()` race: `path` can be replaced with a symlink between the type/owner checks and `open(O_RDWR)` — should use `open(O_RDWR|O_NOFOLLOW)` plus `fstat()` on the fd.

FINDING: bridged_metrics_sink_10.c:resolve_record_1003 | CWE-457 | When `s->have_key` is false, `key[32]` is left uninitialized and still used as the XOR keystream — use of uninitialized stack memory in a cryptographic path.

FINDING: bridged_plugin_loader_11.c:verify_record_1106 | CWE-338 | Security tokens generated with `srand(time(NULL))`/`rand()` — weak PRNG with a seconds-granularity seed makes tokens predictable and guessable.

FINDING: bridged_auth_frontend_12.c:compact_beacon_1209 | CWE-798 | Hard-coded fallback credentials (`svc_backup` / `Br1dge-Ops-2024!`) return `AUTH_OK` unconditionally — backdoor auth bypass with plaintext credentials in source.

FINDING: bridged_archive_manifest_13.c:prune_record_1308 | CWE-208 | Secret comparison returns on the first mismatching byte — early-exit timing side channel; comparison must be constant-time.

FINDING: bridged_reassembly_window_14.c:verify_ticket_1403 | CWE-476 | `header_lookup()` result is passed to `strncasecmp()` without a NULL check — NULL pointer dereference (remote DoS) when `Content-Type` is absent.

FINDING: bridged_control_socket_15.c:encode_policy_1506 | CWE-120 | Wire-controlled `p->hdr.payload_len` is used directly as the `memcpy()` length with no validation against the actual packet length or `dst` capacity — out-of-bounds read and write.

FINDING: bridged_request_demultiplexer_00.c:claim_segment_0006 | CWE-191 | Arena guard `a->used > a->cap - aligned` underflows when `aligned > cap`, so oversized requests succeed and write past the arena (triggered whenever requested `sz` exceeds arena capacity); this identical pattern is duplicated in ~20 functions across the codebase.

## Prioritised remediation summary

**P0 — RCE / auth bypass (fix before any deployment)**
1. `merge_record_0602`: remove `system()` entirely; `execve("/usr/bin/tar", {"tar","-tzf",path}, env)` with `archive_name` validated against an allowlist (`[A-Za-z0-9._-]`, no separators).
2. `seal_backlog_0504`: `syslog(LOG_NOTICE, "%s", line)` — never pass variable data as a format string.
3. `compact_beacon_1209`: delete the hard-coded backdoor and rotate the exposed password everywhere it was committed; rely on the backend with a documented break-glass procedure.
4. `emit_policy_0005`: replace `strcpy` with a bounded copy (`snprintf`/`strlcpy` into `sizeof(scratch)`); the code already computes `n` — use it.
5. `encode_policy_1506` and `claim_record_0805`: validate lengths before any copy — reject `len < 0`, and check declared `payload_len` against bytes actually received and destination capacity.
6. `flush_record_0104`: compute the size in `size_t` with `__builtin_mul_overflow` (or `elem_size && total/elem_size == count`) before the limit check.

**P1 — memory corruption / DoS**
7. `reset_chunk_0308`: log before freeing (or copy the fields), and return immediately after the free path.
8. `rebalance_cursor_0402`: single ownership — free once and set `tmpbuf = NULL` immediately.
9. `rebalance_digest_0204`: loop with `i < dst_sz`; guarantee termination within bounds.
10. `verify_ticket_1403`: NULL-check the header value before `strncasecmp`.
11. Arena guard (all ~20 copies): replace with `if (aligned > a->cap - a->used) return -ENOMEM;`.

**P2 — crypto, session, race**
12. `verify_record_1106`: generate tokens from `getrandom(2)` or the platform CSPRNG.
13. `prune_record_1308`: constant-time comparison (accumulate OR of differences, or `CRYPTO_memcmp`).
14. `resolve_record_1003`: reject or initialize when `!have_key`; longer term, replace the repeating-key XOR scheme with an AEAD (the XOR construction leaks the session key under known plaintext).
15. `reset_bucket_0906`: `open(O_RDWR|O_NOFOLLOW)` then `fstat()` the resulting fd for type/owner checks.
16. `rebalance_policy_0702`: canonicalize with `realpath()` and enforce a `DOC_ROOT` prefix; reject any `..` component.

**Systemic note:** the tree is dominated by copy-pasted helper variants (the arena bug alone exists ~20 times). Consolidate into single audited primitives so one fix covers all instances, and add coverage: fuzz the request demultiplexer, header parser, and control socket; build with `-D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=3`, `-fstack-protector-strong`, and sanitizers in CI. The remaining duplicated helpers (writev loop, hash probe, stats accumulator, bounded copy) were reviewed and, aside from the arena guard above, do not exhibit exploitable defects on the code shown.
